purpose: Blender-authored reference doe with anatomical limb chains and actual morph targets for realistic Atlas fauna customization.

artDirection.summary: Natural deer-like browsing doe with cloven hooves, distinguishable elbow/carpus and stifle/hock, tapered muzzle, lateral eyes, cupped ears and restrained short coat. Species-specific anatomy review precedes acceptance.
artDirection.negativePrompt: smooth toy animal, disconnected limb masses, spherical muzzle, reversed elbow/stifle, horse hoof, baked directional shadows, exaggerated glossy skin

visual: Front, side and three-quarter silhouettes read as an adult doe against attributed deer references; face and cloven feet survive close inspection
Elbow, carpus, stifle, hock and fetlock have separate anatomically appropriate landmarks
Neutral, adult/juvenile and interacting morph extremes preserve plausible anatomy and attachment clearance
Short-coat surface response and eyes remain natural under neutral and grazing illumination; no baked directional light
technical: GLB passes assetctl validation and Blender reimport; explicit UVs, metre scale, Y up and Atlas +X forward
LOD0 at most 20000 triangles, 3 materials, 2048 texture dimension; at most 48 bones and 4 normalized skin influences per vertex

Original deer-coat-1 maps evaluated on the neutral surface: base color and tangent normal at most 2048 square, ORM at most 1024 square; total shared decoded RGBA8 mip estimate at most 48 MiB on desktop
Actual GLB embeds nonconstant base color, normal and roughness maps with correct material bindings; metallic zero, no baked occlusion or directional light; seam and morphed shading review required
At most 16 named morph targets; neutral joint transforms and per-target local joint deltas agree with exported GLB
Mesh and joint changes agree at neutral, individual extremes and paired extremes; original source and prior candidates remain unchanged
Authoring manifest records source brief hash, tool version, seed, file hashes, authorship and unresolved acceptance status
runtime: Creature Lab loads the authored asset and genuine morphs without errors; saved specimen links reproduce controls
Six nearby animals, repeated switches and disposal preserve bounded geometry/skeleton/texture resources; report CPU/GPU frame costs and memory
Individual coat identity, catalogue IDs and dated replay are preserved
Desktop candidate only until actual animation/deformation review and separate headset qualification; no XR approval inferred

provenance.prompt: Author an anatomically grounded deer-like doe with connected organic contours, explicit limb joints, cloven hooves, weighted rig, actual shape keys, joint deltas and preserved Blender source.
provenance.negativePrompt: toy primitives, omitted elbow/stifle, one generic reversed knee, unarticulated appendages

restrictions: Review candidate: resolve original asset license and visual/runtime acceptance before packaging for publication

provenance.notes: Original mesh/material authoring with no imported human mesh or learned model input. References guide anatomy but are not embedded into assets. CharacterCreator-derived runtime algorithms carry separate MIT attribution. Fixed output names describe eventual packaged deliverables; candidate runs write fresh review directories. LODs and production movement are subsequent gates, not supplied by this initial neutral asset brief.

experiments.selectionMetric: Deer anatomy, neutral silhouette, morph/joint consistency, deformation quality and measured runtime cost
